snippet.title: Echofall | Official Gameplay Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Control gravity. Control the battlefield.

Echofall is a high-mobility sci-fi FPS built around full directional gravity control. Rotate gravity at will, transform walls into floors, ceilings into escape routes, and vertical arenas into tactical advantages. Master fluid movement and survive relentless, escalating combat encounters.


Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3805770/Echofall/
